$comment: The start formations the call animation offers, one entry per call card the manual teaches.
SCHEMA. Each card is { "name", "citation", "starts" }. `name` is the manual's call title -- the
entry is keyed by a code like m01a, which says nothing on its own. `starts` is keyed by the START
FORMATION as the manual names it (its own wording, e.g. "Infacing Circle of 8"), and each value is
A tam matches a query when every attribute the query names matches that <tam> in the corpus XML.
`from` is the start formation the engine reports; `title` picks the call instance, because one
manual title covers many tams (Circle Left/Right (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, Full) is ten of them). A start
with "calls": [] is one the manual lists but no authoring can animate.
ORDER MATTERS. The first start resolved must be the authoring the page already showed, or
make-animations.mjs refuses to build: the selector may not change the default animation.
CARDS WITH NOTHING VERIFIED YET have "starts": {} -- scaffolding, filled in later. They are
deliberately not guessed at: an automatic pass over the manual offered California Twirl
"Lines Facing Out" where the manual says Normal Couple only, and read the Centers In card out of
Written without a BOM: JSON.parse refuses one.
